newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close down, uptrend seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close down, uptrend seen.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished lower on Friday as several major banks continued to liquidate their excess funds, but dealers expected the rates to rise gradually next week.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.276 percent against Thursday's 5.470 close, with 30-day commercial paper down to 5.25 against 5.40.

Government bond yields were stable, with the 10-year 84/1 bond yield at 5.65. The market would likely adopt a wait-and-see attitude before the central bank's board meeting, scheduled for next Thursday, dealers said. -- Julie Hu (2-5080815)
